title: UPS Airlines 2976
summary: UPS Airlines Flight 2976, an MD-11F cargo aircraft, suffered separation of its left engine during takeoff roll from runway 17R. The engine, with most of its pylon still attached, separated and tumbled over the wing. The aircraft descended rapidly, struck multiple buildings and vehicles, and crashed into an industrial area. All three crew and twelve ground occupants were killed.
probable_cause: During takeoff, shortly after rotation, the left engine, with most of its pylon still attached, separated from the wing. NTSB revealed that Boeing asked the FAA to increase the inspection interval for lugs from 19,900 to 29,200 flight cycles even though it had received five reports of the spherical bearing fracturing long before the aircraft reached its designated inspection interval.
